title: D-parts: part limit counts every NestedPart
description: draft-ietf-mimi-content-09 §9.1: 'too many body parts (more than 1024)'. Readings: (a) every NestedPart counts, including the root and each MultiPart container, i.e. every node that gets a part index under §4.4 and Appendix B.3; (b) only leaf parts count. Chosen: (a). It matches the spec's own part numbering, it is the stricter bound, and it caps the total work a decoder does. Extends D11 (mimid-1wgh.2.19). Encoder and decoder both enforce it.
